title: Pick Your Floor
notes: Training Tower: new big CHOOSE YOUR FLOOR box. Press -10 / -1 / +1 / +10 and FIGHT FLOOR X. Every floor in the list is clickable too.
Removed the sun halo on S-Rank monsters.
Rank Exam now also needs the gate boss (Floor 10) of your current rank. The Arena shows what is missing.
Master League: smaller XP and Gold per win, so your level no longer explodes and the climb to Lv 99 lasts longer.
